acceptance_gate_results.principle: Authenticated inputs and original flags must be clean before replay.
Prediction and feedback events must be hash-bound and replay without error.
Every checkpoint must chain to its prior checkpoint without gap.
Segmented restart replay must equal uninterrupted full replay.
Duplicate feedback must be rejected and fail closed.
No-feedback arm must never mutate its initial state.
Mandated generator weights must not be modified.
All required validation checks must exit zero.
Upper log loss delta against primary comparators must be strictly negative.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Name unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF for any planned current LLM task; use [] for tasks with no LLM work.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each row names check, validity-or-benefit category, op, expected, observed, passed and principle.
field_principles.checkpoint_event_shards: Numeric checkpoints occur every 32 groups and at final group.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: True: updates use earlier feedback and affect later predictions in an ordered replay.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure real current work; separate load/forward/generation, numeric computation and validation. Never pad time.
field_principles.execution_venue: host; keep CPU/CUDA identity separate from compute class and archived external-device evidence.
field_principles.feedback_event_shards: Losses and state updates reference immutable prediction events.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain field intent here; gate fields themselves remain bare scalars, never value/principle wrappers.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Preserve actual critical findings. Flagged/disqualified science cannot supply readiness.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* names upstream, exact path, check, field, expected and observed; missing, None and zero are different causes.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_; unchanged external absence uses blocked_* with a specific reason. Preserve prior failure strings when the same condition recurs.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use a truthful string; keep model/device details and historical evidence in typed sidecars.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Declare actual current work. Bounded generation uses 10s, embedding/load only 2s, real full generation 60s; blocked_no_run carries no simulated execution.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Balance loads, forwards and generations: attempted, completed, failed, cancelled and in-flight.
field_principles.mixture_construction_retired: Retire unchanged mixture construction after repeated null.
field_principles.model_invoked: Attempted current model work is distinct from archived or scripted model-shaped events.
field_principles.no_model_weight_mutation: True for the mandated generator; compact online selectors are the only learned parameters.
field_principles.online_capture_complete_score: One requires complete cells and cold-replayable prediction and update events, including null comparisons.
field_principles.online_value_score: Use the unchanged benefit/no-harm/control gates from the registered protocol.
field_principles.outcome_event_shards: Post-prediction outcomes bind labels to immutable prediction hashes.
field_principles.phase_spans: Bind phase timings, progress events, checkpoints and clock segments.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Name the actual source paths, resources, identity and observed gate values before dependent work.
field_principles.prediction_event_shards: Store every expert probability at prediction time with pre-label state.
field_principles.promotion_score: Always zero. This milestone authorizes experiments, not rollout, generator-weight changes or external publication.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze fit, projection, stream and resampling seeds; explain a null when randomness is absent.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, protocol, immutable inputs, row shards and exact validation scope.
field_principles.rows: Per-unit metrics for every arm/group/seed/condition, including failures, censoring and unstarted units.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260920; retain actual UTC start/end and monotonic duration with boot/segment identity.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Separate planned, attempted, completed, failed, censored and unstarted independent units with a fixed stop rule.
field_principles.schema: Use a versioned top-level schema and exact experiment_id, milestone and terminal status.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact upstream bytes, original classes and flags; never rehabilitate history.
field_principles.stage_timing_rows: Keep all five stages and durable acknowledgement costs visible.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record actual scoped argv/environment, exit codes, duration and log hashes, including both terminal readers.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum: positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. partial means unfinished OWN retryable work only.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True if the deployed verifier supplies the scoring authority; exact/synthetic oracle success is circular_positive.
